Crested Guan. Scientific name: penelope purpurascens. #costarica
Selfies and pictures around my keynote at AAAI yesterday.

From Nikkei Shimbun: “Leveraging Open Generative AI, Japanese Startups Introduce New Services in a Month Domestic startups are rapidly developing high-performance generative AI (artificial intelligence). This surge in activity comes as leading companies like Meta have taken steps to "open up" their foundational technologies for free use, making it easier for newcomers to incorporate the achievements of pioneers. By modifying these foundational technologies, these startups are managing to launch services within remarkably short development periods of 1 to 3 months. Via Christopher Cuong Nguyen
Achievement unlocked: A 100-meter portrait of me was displayed on the Burj Khalifa in Dubai tonight. I'm in Dubai for the World Government Summit.

- NYC when I left: rain. - Paris when I left: rain. - Dubai when I arrived: two solid days of rain and thunderstorms. - local guy: restaurants, government buildings, and some roads are shut down. - me: really? That's like a big snowstorm in NYC! - local: yeah, no drainage system. - me: 😲 - local: they have big tanker trucks pumping water out of the streets - me: how often does that kind of rain happen? - local: first time in 7 years - me: 😲 - local: people love it.

I'm old enough to remember when "performant" was not a word in English. But it was widely used in French for as long as I can remember. https://books.google.com/ngrams/graph?content=performant&year_start=1960&year_end=2019&corpus=en-2019&smoothing=7&case_insensitive=true

A big bunch of nails in the coffin of the idea that open source AI models are more dangerous than closed ones. And a huge warning to regulators who are on the way to throw the AI baby with the regulatory bath water. What has been happening since the release of Llama-2 is an explosion of applications built on top of open source LLMs, and none of the catastrophe scenarios the AI doomers had predicted. Report from Stanford HAI: https://hai.stanford.edu/issue-brief-considerations-governing-open-foundation-models
VICReging with Randall at NeurIPS. https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.00633
With Ravid and Ido in front of our NeurIPS poster "reverse engineering Self-Supervised Learning" https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.15614
